5 out of 5 stars
Fantastic for school. Purchased 4 of these!
My kids were needing new backpacks for school every year. Sometimes halfway through a school year, their book bags would be wearing out and shoulder straps would be falling apart. Kids these days have so many books and binders to carry around. I couldn’t find anything that would hold up. I finally bought one of these bags for my highschooler and it has been the best purchase ever. She has used her purple one for 2 years already and it’s still fine to use for this coming school year as well. It has worked out so well that I replaced all my kids book bags with this exact one- just different colors. I just purchased my 4th one last night. I am confident that this bag will hold up for anyone. If my kids can stuff these things full of heavy books, binders, water bottles and lunchboxes for a year straight and it be fine enough to use again, then this is a good quality backpack!

    I packed a whole city and almost got arrested!
    Reviewed in the United States on August 8, 2026
    Color: BlackStyle: Travel Backpacks

    I packed a whole city and almost got arrested

    ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

    I am a traveller with a problem: too much stuff. I had already checked two suitcases and still had luggage that could fill a small village. So I bought this SHRRADOO Extra Large Travel Laptop Backpack because I needed something that could swallow my belongings without looking suspicious.

    When it arrived, I was honestly disappointed. It looked small. I thought, “This thing can barely fit a rat, let alone my entire life.” But then I started packing. And packing. And packing. Different compartments, hidden pockets, secret zip zones, nice color combinations, travel friendly, this bag is like a magician’s hat. I fit clothes, shoes, gadgets, snacks, and maybe a small city and the entire Amazon. I am pretty sure I probably packed a house and a car too.

    The zippers are strong. The fabric is tough. And when I put it on my shoulders, the straps were so soft and comfortable I almost cried. I thought I had won. I walked past the airline ground support with confidence, they didn’t suspect a thing. But then came TSA. The scanner lit up like Christmas. They saw the entire city inside my bag. I was flagged. They searched it and found the Mayor tucked in one pocket. Everyone was shocked. How did I pack so much?

    Lesson learned: the bag is amazing, but it will make you look like a suspect when you packed a city!

    Now for the aftermath. When I arrived home, my shoulders and back were screaming for mercy for three days. I could barely lift my arms as they ache from the weight. But you know what? It was worth it. I carried my whole world on my back and survived to tell the tale.

    If you need a backpack that can hold everything and make you feel like a superhero (with back pain), buy this bag. It is a beast.

    10/10. Would pack a city again 😂🎒🌆💀

    1yr in still going strong

    2024 update 4yrs in this bag is STILL going strong. I’m starting to see others rocking this brand on their commutes. This bag has traveled no less than 30k miles by car, train and planes. It’s my go to travel bag. The absolute best.

    (2021) I wanted to write this review after 1yr of use. This bag has held up extremely well! On par with LL Bean for quality and durability but with thicker material. The reason I picked this up is because I needed something bigger than my deluxe LLB to fit my 17” laptop in that would also accommodate the laptops protective zip case. I looked at several different brands and ultimately landed with this one because of the great reviews and the warranty.

    What sold me was the law student review with all her textbooks. Yup if it can carry all those around for 1yr of law school this bag has the durability I need. If you want to save money on a weight fitness vest you can easily throw a couple 20lb weights in this thing and run up and down flights of stairs for a fraction of the cost and plenty of weight scalability.

    For normal users this bag is amazing. There are plenty of storage pockets and device protection within those pockets. This bag can carry anything. And in my case it has. From overnight bag to technology bag and everything in between.

    I’ve packed 17” laptop (in case) with iPad chargers cables and VR headset along with water bottle and snacks to bring to a friends. I’ve carried board games and clothes. Hiking gear etc. everything has fit and stored very well

    The straps and top handle are sturdy the zippers remain resilient. They do not catch and seal and track seamlessly no hiccups or jerks along the way. Sometimes it’s tight around the 17” laptop in its protective case and the zippers still work well and seal tightly despite the stress out on them. I’ve loaded this thing up with easily 50lbs of gear and hauled it on my back and it has stood the test of time

    There are no rips or tears in the materials, handles, straps or zippers. The water bottle netting is holding strong, too.

    I love all the pockets for organization purposes. I love how deep and wide this pack is. Deep enough to hold the big laptop. Wide enough to accommodate an oculus headset alongside in the middle pocket. Enough protection that I feel comfortable carrying these gadgets in the bag.

    This has become my go to bag for everything. Several times I have thought to buy another one. I don’t have a use for 2 but I enjoy it so much because of its versatility and durable reliability that it might be nice to have a backup.

    Friends and family are amazed but how much I fit in this bag. They go to lift it and I say don’t pick it up that’s heavy, I’ve got it. They laugh and go to pick it up and pause to gather their strength and lift and are impressed that I carry it around and then the fact that it holds so much. This bag keeps me strong and in shape for sure. It is also strong.

    Outdoor enthusiasts will love this bag. It can carry ski boots, hiking gear, gym gear, sports or sparring gear, picnic supplies, weekend away bag, tailgating gear, you name it. This bag carries it all.

    I'm a 48-year-old teacher, so my back has been through a lot. But this SHRRADOO backpack? It's genuinely great.

    I originally bought two for myself and for my wife.     Then I saw it was on sale, and I went a little overboard.

    I bought four more as gifts for:

    1. My nephew in college (he uses it for classes and weekend camping)

    2. My friend who travels for work (it's airline approved and fits under the seat)

    3. My neighbor who hikes

    4. And my own teenager, who kept "borrowing" mine anyway

    The quality is really top tier. I've stuffed this thing under airplane seats, strapped it to a camping chair, dropped it in a puddle, and used it as a pillow on a delayed flight. Still looks brand new. The 20+ pockets mean I don't lose my keys or charger anymore.

    If you're a teacher, a gamer, a parent, a hiker, or just someone tired of carrying multiple bags, buy this. Especially if it's on sale. Your back will thank you. And your friends will thank you when you inevitably buy them one as a gift too.
